title: Fried Fish Bun
description: A Malaysian-inspired dish, featuring crispy fried fish served on a soft bun. Perfect for a light meal or snack.
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Dredge the fish pieces in salt to coat.
Fry the fish pieces until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain the fried fish on paper towels.
Split the buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the buns by placing a few pieces of fried fish on each bun.
Serve immediately, with optional Malaysian chili sauce on the side.
